issues.tag: Final week of the regular season
headline: Guy steals
the last seat
issues.deck: A 14-2 rout of Morgan and Mosby’s loss to Show flip sixth place in the season’s final week.
story: Mosby started the week holding the sixth and final playoff spot, seven category wins ahead of Guy. By Sunday night it belonged to somebody else.

Guy took 14 of 18 categories from Morgan behind a 1.25 ERA and 49 strikeouts in 36 innings. Across the league, Show beat Mosby 12-5. Add it up and Guy finishes 182-182-32, Mosby 180-184-32. Twenty-two weeks, and it came down to two wins.
Guy’s reward is a quarterfinal against Micah, who tuned up by beating Justin 15-3 and passed Travis for fourth on the way out the door.
Mosby’s reward is the consolation bracket and a long winter of looking at that pitching line: a 6.17 ERA and 22 walks in 35 innings.
Elsewhere, John closed out a lost season by taking 14 categories from Travis, who had already clinched and threw 27 innings all week.

headline: Crochet changes
hands twice
issues.deck: John bought him from Morgan on Feb. 19 and sold him to Paul a week later, the loudest of 13 trades in February.
story: February is when the 2026 off-season woke up. After one trade in December and none in January, 13 went through in 28 days, the most in a single month since February 2021.

John was in the middle of it. On Feb. 19 he sent four picks to Morgan for Garrett Crochet and four picks back. On Feb. 26 he flipped Crochet to Paul for 9.4, 12.7 and a 2027 10th-rounder, and graded on results he won that one 81-19. Crochet gave Paul 0.0 value points in 2026.

Preston made four deals and lost three of them on results. The one that stings: on Feb. 24 he sent Geraldo Perdomo, the best free-agent pickup in league history, and three picks to Morgan for 9.8, 14.8 and 22.5. Morgan wins it 74-26.
Carter's best work was his quietest. He gave Justin 12.8 for Ben Rice and 16.6 on Feb. 22. Rice gave him 13.4 value points, and Carter finished second.
